media.title: The Morning Mist
media.content:
The Morning Mist

A thick white mist lay over the valley early in the morning. It looked like a soft, fluffy blanket covering the coffee trees and grass. As the sun slowly rose behind the hills, the mist began to disappear into the warm air. Dew drops on the leaves shone like tiny diamonds in the morning light. The cool, fresh air was filled with the sweet smell of damp earth, announcing a beautiful day.

questions.text: What happened to the morning mist when the sun rose?
options: It turned into heavy dark rain clouds
It began to disappear into the warm air
It froze and turned into white snow
questions.answer: It began to disappear into the warm air
